title: If stardew valley release nowaday. Would it called clone slop? AI assets flip.
author: Free-Version-2746
selftext: What truly make stardew valley different?

comments.author: M4xs0n
comments.body: Probably, yeah. These AI haters usally don’t think twice before calling something out as AI Slop. Even if it isn’t

comments.author: ponderdiggums
comments.body:
https://preview.redd.it/dl5fi0sicouh1.png?width=1015&format=png&auto=webp&s=1b9af0331c317f8e90466dfb53a5140fe77ad236

Passion project over the course of years. Personally designed, drew, and programmed -  original art, animations, music and code from scratch. Nothing is really giving clone slop or asset flip here. I am a little confused, where is this question coming from?

replies.author: HitlersArse
replies.body: someone probably told them that their project was ai slop and they got salty

replies.author: Big_Whale_95
replies.body: What should it even be cloned from ? Did they not even technically set a new subgenre? Or made it popular again ?

comments.author: RickRelentless
comments.body: No? There’s a million cozy farm sims now but they didnt exist before Stardew, other than Harvest Moon which wasnt nearly as popular as Stardew Valley went on to become. Stardew Valley spawned an entire genre, why would a game like that ever be considered slop?

comments.author: mallcopsarebastards
comments.body: what are you even asking. concernedape made all the art in stardew himself from scratch. Stardew is the worst possible example here because it's the epitome of creator does literally everything and cuts zero corners.

comments.author: Sleepnotdeading
comments.body:
A deep farming/life sim with clever systems and careful crafting at every level of play, that set a standard for cozy games, developed by one guy and maintained thoughtfully for over a decade.

What makes it different is that it obviously isn’t slop.  It’s the standard that gets lesser made clones correctly called out as slop.

comments.author: Ball_Analytics
comments.body: Something called [Harvest Moon](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harvest_Moon_(video_game)) that could never be recreated until he did it, used to take turns with my sister to skip school just to play that game. Nostalgia was the reason it would not even be close to being called that.

comments.author: mxblacksmith
comments.body: What are you smoking? I can do art and code, but concernedape is on another level, which I consider a genius. The pixel art is top-notch, the music is perfect, and the game loop is addicting.
